metric: Stars retained on the repository at fetch time, grouped by the month their stars were created. This is not historical total stars, net star growth, or all stars ever received; removed stars are absent and past buckets can change.

last_good.source_boundary_note: Monthly buckets assign each source daily bin by its week timestamp plus day offset; GitHub week/day boundaries may differ from UTC, so month-boundary attribution is approximate.
